notes.title: Party on Hallow Grove is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4_Tna84-OpA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][b]Party on Hallow Grove is out NOW![/b][/h1]

[h2][i]When the leaves fall, and the wind gets chilly, there’s a space, between here and there…
Where all the monsters go…
To party. Hardy.[/i][/h2]

[i]Halloween season is here[/i], and that means it's Death's birthday. 

In Party on Hallow Grove, you are Blacky, Death's best friend, and you've been invited to his party this year. There's only one problem: when you get there, nothing's ready. Oh, and also, everyone's being an asshole. So that's two problems, I guess...

So it's up to you to explore Death's mansion, talk to quirky guests, trade party items, and play some party music - all before Death wakes up. In this adventure, you'll laugh, make friends, and learn to be kind to one another - and when the party is crashed by an unexpected guest, you’ll be faced with your biggest challenge yet.

[h3]Thank you to everyone who has followed development and played the demo!
I hope you all enjoy this whacky, funny and bizarre adventure.[/h3]

Hey everyone!

Party on Hallow Grove is on [b]STEAM NEXT FEST[/b]!!

The Demo is live and available to play now on the game's store page!The demo is a prequel, where you get to play as Dracula before Blacky arrives to help with the party. You get a small taste of the full game, with small side quests, jokes, and events unique to the Demo.
